verdicts.reason: The Cyprus Ministry of Finance eCustoms page contains the quote verbatim: import customs declarations and the import manifest at national level may be submitted electronically through 'THESEAS Customs Electronic systems', and elsewhere calls THESEAS the 'Import System'. The printed name and scope (import declarations and manifests) match exactly; nothing is added.

The Politis article (Cyprus section, about Cyprus Police leak investigations) contains the Greek quote verbatim: every police officer has two unique codes for access to a computer and to 'το μηχανογραφικό σύστημα της Αστυνομίας'; the page also calls it 'το πληροφοριακό σύστημα της Αστυνομίας'. The printed descriptive name (Police computerised information system, per-officer access codes) matches;
